name: Chadickith
subclass: Order of the Pale Moon (Giant Owl curse)

attacks.name: Beast Form talons (giant owl; Rite Die d6)

inventory: Explorer's pack (backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, 10 torches, waterskin, 50 ft hempen rope)
A small ember-black stone from Okton's forge (keepsake)
Silver key token on a cord (Ember Keep gate-sergeant, dawn bell)
Grey burial-notice note from a Pyrewarden (Ashward almshouse, tomorrow's dusk bell)
Iron gate key on a cord (Peret's; opens the plague road gate to the Pyrehouse crypt)
Peret's list of six Ashward names with marks and dates
Redcollar gorget (loaned by Okton) and a red peace-cord for the greataxe
features: Natural Armor (AC 12 + CON)
Loxodon Serenity (adv. vs charmed/frightened)
Trunk (5 ft reach; grapple/lift/unarmed strike; can't wield weapons; in Hybrid Form it is a tail)
Keen Smell
Powerful Build
Strike of the Giants: Fire (+1d10 fire once per turn on melee or thrown weapon hit; PB uses/long rest)
BLOOD HUNTER 3 (Alternate, laserllama v2.2; see Books/alternate-blood-hunter-notes.md). Rite Die d4, Rite save DC 13 (8+PB+CON), 2 Blood Rites
Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting (heavy melee weapon damage dice that roll below average count as average: d12 min 6)
Hunter's Bane: Occult Lore (Arcana proficiency); Sinister Insight (bonus action, CON check with Arcana/Nature/Religion by creature type, DC 8+CR)
Blood Rite: Binding (bonus action, Large or smaller, STR save or speed 0 and no reactions until end of your next turn; free once per rest, then Vital Sacrifice)
Blood Rite: Revelation (when using Sinister Insight, auto-succeed; empowered: ignore one damage Immunity/Resistance for 1 minute)
Crimson Offering (bonus action + Vital Sacrifice; 1 hour; weapon deals Rite Die extra acid/cold/fire/lightning/poison damage)
Vital Sacrifice (reduce current AND max HP by Rite Die until long rest; cannot be done if it would reduce current HP to 0)
Pale Moon: Feral Senses (add Rite Die to Perception/Survival checks by sight/hearing/smell; Sinister Insight vs Beast/Monstrosity/Shapeshifter)
Pale Moon: Lycanthropic Curse (Giant Owl; bonus action Shift into Beast Form or Hybrid Form; once per rest free, else Vital Sacrifice; up to 1 hour)
Hybrid Form: +10 ft speed, climb speed = walk, unarmed strikes finesse for Rite Die piercing/slashing, bonus action unarmed strike or Dash (Wild Fury)
Beast Form (Giant Owl): beast statistics but keep HP, INT/WIS/CHA, skills and Blood Rites; Large, fly 60 ft, talons use Rite Die and Rite DC
Proficiencies: light and medium armor, shields, simple and martial weapons, alchemist's supplies
Languages: Common; Loxodon; Giant; Draconic

Feat (level 4): Grappler (XPHB 2024, +1 STR): Punch and Grab (an Unarmed Strike hit can do damage and grapple, once per turn); advantage on attacks against a creature you grapple; no extra movement to move a grappled creature your size or smaller

Level 5 (milestone): Extra Attack (attack twice when you take the Attack action); Grim Psychometry (cast identify as a ritual using alchemist's supplies as the material components; also learn whether the object is cursed and the nature of the curse); Rite Die d6; proficiency bonus +3; Rite save DC 14
notes: Age 76 (young for a loxodon). Egotistical know-it-all who gets humbled often. Born in Hadrun (Cinder Hills) to Berov and Radanya, who died when a blood-raged roc destroyed the village in 1423 DR, when he was 8. Raised for 68 years by Okton, a fire giant smith of Kharun, who calls him 'Small Tusk'. Member of Okton's Order of the Banked Fire and now HAS undergone the blood ritual: Okton quenched him in round 6 of the roc fight (class changed from Barbarian 3 / Storm Herald to Blood Hunter 3 / Pale Moon, giant owl curse). 7 ft, 318 lb, tortoiseshell coat of lion-tan and bistre fur. AC 15 = Natural Armor (12 + CON). Vital Sacrifice (owl flight, day 8): max HP 16 until a long rest (normal max 35). LEVEL 4 (milestone): STR 16, Grappler. Normal max HP 45; Vital Sacrifice reduction of 19 until a long rest. LEVEL 5 (day 9 dawn war-table). Normal max HP 55; Vital Sacrifice reduction of 19 until a long rest.
